text:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT • Orpheus (orpheus-prod-vpc-3) — increased tool/fncall parse errors during streaming/paging. Severity: P1-customer-impact. Initial spike at 2026-03-15T10:12:57Z. 20% of streaming toolcalls returning parser errors / truncated payloads. Affected: dedicated VPC pool 3 (tenant: Orpheus). Auto-escalation to on-call.

marta: saw it. paging @ryan oncall. is it just streaming endpoints or normal requests too?

ryan: I’m on it. getting logs now. earliest signs ~10:12 UTC across a handful of pods in pool-3.

dan: looks like toolcall responses are arriving as concatenated json frames in the stream. Parser sees multiple top-level objects -> JSONDecodeError. sample from logs:

```
2026-03-15T10:13:02Z orpheus-pool3-12 svc-runtime: stream chunk: '{"tool_response": {...}}\n{"tool_response":null, "meta":{}}'
json.decoder.JSONDecodeError: Extra data: line 1 column 256 (char 255)
```

keiko: interesting — we recently changed the chunking boundary code in runtime 2.7.1, maybe reassembly bug. Could be partial-frame + paging boundary collision. Only hitting large streaming responses (long tool outputs) used by Orpheus reconciliation job.

marta: customer impact: their reconciliation jobs are failing with 502s, they reported timeouts in the dashboard. Notify support? @keiko can we scope if this is tenant-isolated to Orpheus?

keiko: yes logs show pool-3 only. no cross-tenant noise. tracing: requests from orpheus-prod-vpc-3.* only. Not hitting dedicated pool-1/2.

ryan: immediate mitigation idea: disable streaming for Orpheus routes (force non-streaming responses) or fall back to non-streaming model variant in routing policy. Rolling that change should be low-risk and restore correct toolcall framing.

dan: agree. alternative: patch parser to be tolerant by reading multiple JSON objects and emitting last one — but that's risky for correctness/timestamp ordering.

marta: action plan now:
1) apply routing override for tenant orpheus to disable streaming (force non-stream) — Keiko to apply.
2) increase request timeout and enable retry on client for recon jobs — Ryan to coordinate with Orpheus.
3) collect sample failing payloads and escalate to runtime team for a fix and test harness — Dan to own.

keiko: applying override now via admin API. command:

```
curl -X POST "https://admin.redwood/api/v1/routing/overrides" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"tenant":"orpheus","pool":"pool-3","force_non_stream":true,"reason":"mitigate streaming chunk parse errors"}'

# response: {"override_id":"ovr-20260315-001","status":"applied"}
```

keiko: override applied on 3 nodes. patch will propagate via control plane; should be immediate for new sessions.

ryan: pinged Orpheus SRE via their support channel to route ephemeral traffic away and restart a few failing jobs. Asked them to confirm after 1-2 min.

incident-bot: NOTE: routing override ovr-20260315-001 applied by keiko. Rolling change: 3/3 nodes acknowledged.

orpheus-support (via ticket): we see errors dropping. some jobs re-run and pass. thanks.

dan: pulled more logs from node orpheus-pool3-12 after override. streaming disabled -> responses now sent as single JSON payloads. sample:

```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json
Content-Length: 4123
{
  "tool_response": { ... large object ... },
  "meta": {"paging": {"next_token": null}}
}
```

keiko: good. temporary mitigation successful. next: reproduce locally and add robust reassembly tests. I’ll create a runtime branch to revert the chunk-boundary change and add a unit/integ test against concatenated frames.

dan: assigning myself to reproduce with a simulated long tool output and the pooling code. If we can trigger it in integration, we can decide whether the bug is in chunker or in network reassembly.

marta: customer comms: keiko please coordinate with support on a short note — "we applied a temporary routing override to disable streaming for your tenant while we investigate; no further action required. We're investigating root cause and will follow up with timeline." 

keiko: will do. drafting now.

ryan: monitoring metrics: error-rate for pool-3 went from 18% -> 2% within 90s of override. latency increased ~120ms on average for those jobs (expected tradeoff).

marta: good. we should schedule a handoff to eng-runtime for a detailed fix. Dan owns reproduction + PR. Keiko owns revert plan + test. Ryan will follow up with Orpheus SRE for SLA compensation ask if needed.

dan: created issue: RUNTIME-4567 "stream chunking reassembly: extra-data JSONDecodeError under long tool outputs". linking logs and samples. assigning milestone: patch+tests in next sprint. PR branch: fix/chunk-reassembly-20260315

keiko: added a short-term alert to watch for similar errors in pool-3 after we remove override. alert threshold: 1% sustained parser errors over 5min.

marta: handoff: oncall->sre/runtime. Ryan you're handing this to eng-runtime. Please add any remaining follow-ups in the ticket and schedule postmortem. I'll close this alert once postmortem owners confirmed.

ryan: acknowledged. will sync with Dan & Keiko in eng-runtime channel in 15m.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE • mitigation applied (routing override ovr-20260315-001). Severity downgraded to P2-customer-impact-monitoring. Follow-up ticket: RUNTIME-4567. Handed off to eng-runtime.

marta: closing thread for real-time coordination. keep updates in RUNTIME-4567 and eng-runtime. postmortem owner: dan. comms owner: keiko. If we see reoccurrence, reopen.

keiko: uploading sample failing payloads to the ticket and tagging @eng-runtime.

dan: will run a bisect against runtime 2.6.9 -> 2.7.1 to nail down exact commit. will post ETA for fix by EOD. 

ryan: noted. thanks all. :thumbsup:
